result.title: KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads
result.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and benchmark available at https://github.com/Krako-Labs/KORA
result.summary: AI applications often invoke a model before they determine whether inference is necessary. That default is useful for ambiguous generative tasks, but it is poorly matched to work that is structured, deterministic, policy-bound, lookup-oriented, or directly verifiable. KORA introduces deterministic-first execution control: a pre-inference control layer that represents requests as task paths, attempts deterministic or structured routes first, validates route outcomes, records telemetry, and escalates to a model-candidate path only when deterministic handling is insufficient. This paper presents KORA as a deterministic-first execution-control architecture and reports bounded evidence from reproducible benchmark and validation workloads. In a reproducible 100-task deterministic-heavy benchmark, KORA-controlled execution avoided 80 of 100 simulated model invocations versus a naive direct baseline, with zero mismatches in the deterministic subset. The workload is intentionally deterministic-heavy: it includes categories such as FAQ lookup, policy/rule checking, schema or format validation, deterministic transformation, and a smaller set of model-needed ambiguous or generative tasks. A separate synthetic customer-support local/no-network validation workload demonstrates route measurement and avoided model-call accounting in an application-shaped setting. These results support bounded model-invocation reduction and validation visibility in documented workloads. They do not establish production behavior, real-provider outcomes, energy outcomes, API-cost reduction, or broad superiority.

AI.brief_summary: KORA 提出一个推理前控制层，将请求表示为任务路径，先尝试确定性或结构化路由并校验结果、记录遥测，仅在不足时升级为模型调用；在一个确定性任务为主的 100 任务基准上报告避免 80 次模型调用且确定性子集零不匹配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先确定性路由、验证后再升级到模型」的门控逻辑，可能为 LVR 中「是否还需继续计算」的 STOP/计算价值判断提供概念参照；但该工作处于系统编排层，不涉及 latent 状态或视觉证据，联系仅停留在问题表述层面，具体可借鉴性需核查。
